BrochureContent.Content:
A well-positioned two-bedroom second-floor apartment enjoying a superb town-centre location and a private balcony overlooking the River Suir.

Apartment 23, Tower House is an attractive two-bedroom second-floor apartment situated in this highly convenient location, right in the heart of Clonmel town centre. Offering well-proportioned accommodation together with a wonderful outlook over the River Suir.

The accommodation is well laid out and comprises an entrance hallway leading to a bright and spacious open-plan kitchen/dining/living room. This versatile living space provides an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining, with access to the balcony which enjoys a particularly pleasant aspect overlooking the River Suir. There are two well-proportioned bedrooms and a bathroom completing the accommodation.

One of the property's most appealing features is its excellent town-centre location. Situated in Tower House, residents can enjoy immediate access to Clonmel's extensive range of shops, cafés, restaurants, bars and everyday amenities all located quite literally on the doorstep.

With its generous living accommodation, two bedrooms, private balcony and attractive riverside outlook, Apartment 23, Tower House is a property that offers convenience, character and an enviable town-centre lifestyle.
